title: Billing and Coding: Intervertebral Disc Repair

codes.1: The following CPT/HCPCS codes are noncovered. If using an unspecified CPT/HCPCS code, add the description of “intradiscal injection.” Both the procedure and associated drug(s) will be denied. Use of CPT/HCPCS 62290 for services defined in this policy will be considered incorrect coding.
